title: Isandro and the Inventory
author: W. M. Zhou
blurb: Petra Almeida, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must return to the place where the story went wrong before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
